faqs.q: Sec. 18-514. - I.P.M.C. Section 308.3, Disposal of garbage.
faqs.a:
Section 308.3. Disposal of garbage,
is amended to read as follows:
"
308.3. Disposal of garbage.
Every occupant of a structure shall dispose of garbage in a clean and sanitary manner
                  by placing such garbage in an approved garbage disposal facilities or garbage containers."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
